public.title: Maximal Square
public.description: Return the area of the largest all-one square in a rectangular binary matrix. Empty matrices and zero-width rows return zero. Dimensions are at most 100 by 100.
hints: Store the square side ending at each cell.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A one cell extends a square by one plus the minimum of top, left and diagonal side lengths. Track the greatest side, then square it. O(rows times columns) time and O(columns) space.
